cm_eyes3_legs4.text: Hello, Mumba! I'd like a new friend with three eyes and four legs, please!

cm_eyes4_legs6_spots5.text: I'd like a friend with four eyes, six legs and five spots, please!

cm_yes.text: It matches my card! Thank you!

cm_not.text: Hmm. That's not quite like my card.

fs_intro.text: Mumba baked a cake for the picnic! Cut it so we both get the same!

fs_swipe.text: Swipe across the cake to cut it!

fs_dots.text: The dots can help you aim.

fs_cake3.text: This cake is for three of us. Cut it fairly!

fs_pie4.text: A pie for four friends! Cut it so everyone gets the same.

fs_pie2.text: A round pie for the two of us!

fs_cake4.text: A long cake for four friends!

fs_pie8.text: A big pie for eight! Cut it into eight fair pieces.

fs_cake6.text: A long cake for six friends!

fs_cherries.text: Four friends, twelve cherries. How many each?

fs_name.text: What do we call each piece?

fs_bigger.text: Oh! Mine is bigger. That is not fair!

fs_fair_yes.text: Two small pieces, the same amount! It is fair!

fs_onethird_or.text: Which is more? One third, or one quarter?

fs_more_third.text: One third is more! Sharing with fewer friends gives bigger pieces.

fs_squish.text: Squish it back together, and cut again!

fs_pieces_many.text: Too many pieces! Squish it back together.

ss_intro.text: We weigh the same! Add weights to make the seesaw level.

ss_letgo.text: Press Let go to test it!

ss_two.text: Put two weights that are the same on this side!

ss_three.text: Put three weights that are the same on this side!

ss_notsame.text: Level! But are the weights all the same?

ss_pouch.text: Every pouch holds the same. How much is in one pouch?

ss_pouchtip.text: Take the same off both sides. It stays level!

ss_count.text: Count each side. Which side needs more?

pr_tip.text: Hmm, not quite. Have another look!

pr_quick.text: Now the quick ones! As fast as you can!

ss_up.text: Whee, I'm up high! Bam's side is heavier.

kc_intro.text: Race you! Every right answer is a boost!

kc_dots.text: No hurry! Look at the dots, then type.

kc_time.text: Time's up! Let's look at the board.

kc_win.text: You won! That was a great race!

kc_lose.text: That was close! Shall we race again?

kc_calm.text: We made it! What a race!

ss_heavier.text: Which one is heavier? Tap it!

ss_lighter.text: Which one is lighter? Tap it!

ss_heaviest.text: Which is the heaviest of all? Tap it!

ss_more.text: Which side has more Peeps? Tap it!

ss_fewer.text: Which side has fewer Peeps? Tap it!

ss_sameask.text: Which side has more? Or are they the same?

ss_bigger.text: Which number is bigger? Tap it!

ss_compare.text: Choose less than, equal to, or greater than.

ss_parts.text: Put two weights on Bam's side to make the same total.

ss_anotherway.text: Make that total with two weights a different way.

ss_sentence.text: What goes in the empty box? Use the number buttons, then tap OK.

ss_true.text: Is this number sentence true? Will the seesaw be level?

ss_family.text: These three numbers belong together. Fill each box.

ss_turn.text: Put the same two weights on Bam's side, the other way round.

ss_howmany.text: Bim has more than Bam. Add ones to Bam's side until it is level.

ss_added.text: How many ones did you add? Use the number buttons.

ss_why.text: Move some from the small weight into the big weight. Will it still be level?

ss_sameall.text: Same in all, so it stays level.

ss_follow.text: Follow the clay from one weight to the other. Is the total changing?

ss_hundreds.text: Build this number with hundreds, tens and ones.

ss_watch.text: Watch each side. The heavier side goes down.

ss_match.text: Match one Peep on this side with one on that side. Are any left over?

ss_signhint.text: The open end faces the bigger number. Equal means the same.

ss_partstip.text: There must be two parts. Together they make the whole.

ss_turntip.text: Use the same two weights. Start with the other one.

ss_padtip.text: Look at the weights on both sides. What would make them the same?

ss_work.text: Let's do it together, one step at a time. Then you can try a fresh one.

kc_jump.text: Three in a row! A big jump!

cs_swipe.text: Swipe along a groove to snap it!

cs_again.text: Let's put it back together and try again.

cs_name.text: One piece of the bar is…

cs_tip_name.text: How many pieces make the whole bar? Count them.

cs_snap_both.text: Snap this one for two friends, and this one for four.

cs_equal_bars.text: Make the pieces in each bar the same size.

cs_which_bigger.text: Which piece is bigger? Tap it.

cs_which_smaller.text: Which piece is smaller? Tap it.

cs_tip_lay.text: Lay them on top of each other.

cs_how_many_2.text: How many halves make a whole bar?

cs_how_many_3.text: How many thirds make a whole bar?

cs_how_many_4.text: How many quarters make a whole bar?

cs_tip_whole.text: Put them back together, one at a time, and count them.

cs_paint.text: Give me half. Any shape you like! Tap the squares.

cs_both_half.text: Different shapes, but both are one half!

cs_same_or_not.text: Different shapes! Are they the same amount?

cs_parts.text: Snap off this many for Bim.

cs_ways.text: Snap it any way you like. Can you find another way?

cs_press.text: Press grooves to make the squares.

cs_count.text: Count the squares, a piece at a time.

bl_intro.text: This is our boat! She goes lower with every load. Let's fill her up!

bl_tap_heavy.text: Which one is heavy? It makes the boat go down.

bl_tap_light.text: Which one is light? The boat will hardly move.

bl_test_two.text: Which is heavier? Tap each one, and watch the boat.

bl_test_lighter.text: Which is lighter? Tap each one, and watch the boat.

bl_which_heavier.text: So which one is heavier? Tap it.

bl_which_lighter.text: So which one is lighter? Tap it.

bl_lower_heavier.text: It pushed her lower, so it's heavier!

bl_higher_lighter.text: She stayed higher, so it's lighter!

bl_test_three.text: Tap each one, and watch the boat.

bl_lightest_first.text: Now tap them in order. The lightest first, the heaviest last.

bl_what_heavy.text: How heavy is this crate? Which one tells us?

bl_what_long.text: How long is this plank? Which one tells us?

bl_what_holds.text: How much does this barrel hold? Which one tells us?

bl_load.text: Load her right to the line!

bl_too_heavy.text: Too heavy! The water is over the line. Take one off.

bl_how_heavy.text: How heavy is she now? Add them up.

bl_how_much_more.text: How many more kilos to reach the line?

bl_not_yet.text: She's not at the line yet.

bl_end.text: All the boats are out! Thank you!

pt_intro.text: Welcome to the pit stop! We're the crew!

pt_tip_fill.text: How many empty circles can you see?

pt_tip_pairs.text: Look how many are still empty after the first can.

pt_holds_more.text: Which one holds more? Tap it.

pt_holds_less.text: Which one holds less? Tap it.

pt_pour_both.text: Which holds more? Tap each one, and pour it in.

pt_cups.text: Let's fill them with this mug. Tap a jug to pour one mug in.

tf_intro.text: Oh no, the track is broken! Let's measure it and mend it.

tf_too_short.text: Too short! They can't get across.

tf_too_long.text: Too long! It won't go in.

tf_tap_longer.text: The gap needs the longer rail. Tap it.

tf_tap_shorter.text: The gap needs the shorter rail. Tap it.

tf_tip_compare.text: Look at them lined up. Which one sticks out further?

tf_order.text: Tap the rails in order. Shortest first, longest last.

tf_tip_order.text: Now they're lined up. Which one is shortest?

tf_rope.text: This rail is too heavy to lift and try. Tap the rope. It will measure the gap.

tf_rope2.text: Now tap again. The rope goes beside the rail.

tf_is_it.text: Is the rail too short, just right, or too long?

tf_tip_rope.text: Look at the end of the rope. Does the rail go past it?

tf_another.text: We need a different rail. Here it comes.

tf_blocks.text: How long is the gap? Tap to lay a block. Go right across, with no spaces. Then tap the tick.

tf_tip_blocks.text: The last block must just reach the other side.

tf_how_many_blocks.text: How many blocks long is it?

tf_ruler.text: Slide the ruler. Put its zero right at the start of the gap.

tf_cut.text: Now read the ruler. Drag the scissors along the rail, and cut it at that number.

tf_tip_ruler.text: Look straight up from the end of the gap to the ruler.

tf_read.text: How long is the gap? Read the ruler.

tf_tool.text: Which tool would you use to measure it?

tf_tool_stick.text: A metre stick, for things about as big as you.

tf_tool_tape.text: A long tape, for very long things.

tf_tip_tool.text: Is it small, or as big as you, or very long?

tf_thing_track.text: The whole track, all the way round.

tf_lay_small.text: Tap the small blocks to lay them across the gap.

tf_lay_big.text: Now tap the big blocks to lay them across.

tf_which_more.text: Which blocks did it take more of?

tf_units_why.text: Small blocks, so more of them. Big blocks, so fewer.

tf_about_how_long.text: About how long is the gap? Look at the ruler. Which number is closest?

tf_about_rail.text: Look at the ruler. Which rail is about long enough? Tap it.

tf_about_cut.text: Find the number closest to the end of the gap. Cut the rail at that number.

tf_tip_about.text: Look straight up from the end of the gap. Which number is closest?

tf_how_much_more.text: This rail is too short. How much more do we need?

tf_tip_more.text: Count from the end of the rail to the end of the gap.

tf_story.text: Read the story, and look at the bars. How long?

tf_tip_story.text: Do the bars join up, or do we want the part left over?

tf_post.text: The track needs a post at this number. Drag it there, then press Go.

tf_tip_post.text: Find this number on the ruler first.

tf_hop.text: Start at the Peep, and hop. Where will it land?

tf_tip_hop.text: Hop one at a time, and count the hops.

tf_plot.text: Here's how long each gap was. Put a dot above its number.

tf_tip_plot.text: Find this number on the ruler.

tf_plot_how_many.text: How many gaps were this long?

tf_plot_most.text: Which length came up the most? Tap its number.

tf_plot_total.text: How many gaps are there in all?

tf_tip_plot_count.text: Each dot is one gap. Count the dots.

tf_end.text: The track is mended! Thank you!

pt_end.text: Every kart is back in the race! Thank you!

tf_intro_whole.text: The Peeps want a ride! Let's measure, and keep their track safe.
